Rationale: Filters out all lopsided matches; requires baseline draw density before considering override.
Prevents overriding clear home/away favorites. Only activates when neither team has decisive win advantage.
Ensures that even if win gap is narrow, overall favorite confidence does not exceed 45%.

Excludes mismatches where a heavy favorite has an unmodeled home disadvantage.
